label: Formaggio di fossa
note: Rarely buffalo milk too; matured 20-30 days before burying per Wikipedia (the PDO rules are reported as at least 80 days, sources differ)

about.text: Formaggio di fossa (pit cheese) comes from Sogliano al Rubicone in Emilia-Romagna, where cheese has been buried in pits dug in tufa since the 14th century. Cheese sold as fossa di Sogliano has had protected designation of origin status since 2009.

facts.v: Flask-shaped, about 3 m deep, 2 m across at the base; at least ten years old so the right bacterial colonies live in it
